name: Finset
pow_card_le_prod
result.signature: [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → N) (n : N) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) : n ^ #s ≤ s.prod f
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → n ^ s.card ≤ s.prod f
result.informal_description: Let $ N $ be a commutative monoid equipped with a partial order where left multiplication is monotonic. For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, a function $ f : \iota \to N $, and an element $ n \in N $, if $ n \leq f(x) $ for all $ x \in s $, then $ n^{\#s} \leq \prod_{x \in s} f(x) $.

name: Cardinal
instMul
result.informal_description: The multiplication of two cardinal numbers $\kappa$ and $\lambda$ is defined as the cardinality of the Cartesian product of any two sets representing $\kappa$ and $\lambda$, respectively. This operation is well-defined because the product of bijections between equivalent sets results in a bijection between the products, ensuring the product cardinal depends only on the original cardinals.

    (∀ (i : ι), Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (c i) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk ι)) →
      Cardinal.prod c = 2 ^ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk ι)

result.informal_name: Product of Cardinals Equals 2 to the Power of Index Cardinality
result.informal_description: Let $\iota$ be an infinite set, and let $\{c_i\}_{i \in \iota}$ be a family of cardinals such that for all $i \in \iota$, $c_i \geq 2$ and $c_i \leq |\iota|$. Then, the cardinal product $\prod_{i \in \iota} c_i$ equals $2^{|\iota|}$.

u_s$ is the arithmetic function of the sieve.
